notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year, Toll Keepers!

items.text: May we all gallop into this Year of the Horse with elegance, vitality, and prosperity.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600326/ae51648d89b7b30a8be7c71f50a166628c790eb3.png"]
Alongside this sale, we are excited to present to you the much-requested feature, Endless Mode! Along with some adjustments and QoL improvements for the game.
After you finish the main story, a new mode will become available for you to keep playing and practice your toll-keeping skill. There will be 2 modes available:
[p align="justify"]Timed: Process as many vehicles as possible in 10 minutes.: Perfection: Be the perfect toll keeper where a single mistake results in an immediate Game Over!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600326/35a738b1c9f7ac7a49431e99410887945df792b1.png"]
As you continue to improve your skills, get your highest score, and compete with other players on the Global Leaderboard to prove that you're Metro City's best interim toll-keeper!
In this new mode, as Dewi is currently... occupied, you'll be stepping into the booth as a fresh recruit. You can now create and customize your own character to suit your style!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600326/c193a7308f02694cad31732f684e51dcd4ae88b1.gif"]
We also updated other parts of the main game with several improvements:
Comic Section: Now available in the Extras menu. Get a view of small events happening outside the toll booth.
Ending Hints: There will be hints for locked endings at the gallery after completing the story once.
New Upgrades: Improve your efficiency with the Overweight Indicator, Correct Car Type Indicator, and UV Light Size Increase.
Fair Rejection Rule: (Endless Mode Only) Rejecting a correct driver will result in a penalty.
Fix: Shorten the path displayed when saving the Diary Decoration screenshot.
Thank you so much for your incredible support and feedback that helps us improve this game with every patch. We're so excited to see your names climbing the new leaderboards!
Whether you're aiming for the top of the leaderboards or discovering Janapa for the first time, there’s never been a better time to clock in.
Happy Toll Keeping,
GameChanger Studio
Hey everyone!
We're pushing a small QoL update today regarding item interactables and save files.
Here's the list of changes that we hope will improve your experience:
Make the bills on the cash register & UV lights immediately draggable.
Add another auto-save point in the game: Adding to the daily save (every morning), the auto-save is now also triggered when Dewi's shift is over (every evening).
Add more save slots (up to 30).

We saw that some players' initial reaction when interacting with the UV lights and the cash register is to drag them immediately, only to fail to do so in the previous version. Bills on the cash register & the UV lights are now immediately draggable.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600326/e25fbaf1152f07b91ede1d0eeede82aaf96ae8ed.png"]

Previously, the auto-save only triggered on each new day (in the morning). We saw that some players were taking a break after finishing the diary (before the auto-save is triggered), which caused them to lose their progress. We add another save point to prevent this from happening again. We also add more save slots (ex, the behavior is closer to checkpoints) to accommodate the double save point and also for you to be able to load further save points.
Bug Fixes
Fix some localization
Fix a bug that causes the music volume to be unbalanced
We're continuing to monitor all feedback and bug reports. Thank you for playing 1998: The Toll Keeper Story!
Hey everyone!
We're pushing out another hotfix today to address some major issues you've reported. Thank you for your patience and your bug reports; they really helped us track these down!
Hotfix V1.0.6 - 6 November 2025
Prevent toll income from having a negative value
Fix a bug that causes a penalty when giving the right amount of change
Fix a bug where some events are not triggered if the dialog is skipped
Fix a bug that causes newer save files to fail to overwrite older save files.
Handle render texture fallback on some devices.
Fix some localization
Fix a bug that sometimes causes the game to break when rejecting/reporting a driver.
We're continuing to monitor all feedback and bug reports. Thank you for playing 1998: The Toll Keeper Story!
Hey everyone!
We're pushing out a small but crucial hotfix today to address some major issues you've reported. Thank you for your patience and your bug reports, they helped us track these down!
Hotfix V1.0.5 - 30 October 2025
Fix a bug that cause the game failed to write save data.
Fix a bug that cause the game broken after doing reporting.
Fix some localization issue.
Adjust writing on executive order list.
Removed the Red Cross symbol from ambulances to adhere to the Geneva Convention guidelines.
We're continuing to monitor all feedback and bug report. Thank you for playing 1998: The Toll Keeper Story!
